tagline: Authentic Nepali Cuisine in the Heart of Kathmandu
target_audience: Local residents, tourists, and food enthusiasts seeking authentic Nepali dining experience

seo.title: Himalayan Kitchen - Best Nepali Restaurant in Kathmandu
seo.description: Experience authentic Nepali cuisine at Himalayan Kitchen. Traditional recipes, fresh ingredients, and warm hospitality in the heart of Kathmandu.

sections.title: Taste the Authentic Flavors of Nepal
sections.subtitle: Traditional Recipes, Modern Experience
sections.description: Discover the rich flavors of authentic Nepali cuisine prepared with locally sourced ingredients and generations-old recipes. Join us for an unforgettable dining experience.

sections.title: Our Story
sections.description: Founded in 2015, Himalayan Kitchen has been serving authentic Nepali delicacies to locals and tourists alike. Our chefs bring decades of experience from the kitchens of traditional Nepali households, ensuring every dish tells a story of our rich culinary heritage.

items.name: Traditional Nepali Thali
items.description: Authentic Nepali meal served on a traditional brass plate with rice, dal, vegetables, pickle, and papad

items.name: Momo Making Class
items.description: Learn the art of making perfect Nepali momos with our expert chefs. Available for groups and families

items.name: Catering Services
items.description: Bring the authentic taste of Nepal to your events. We cater weddings, parties, and corporate events

items.name: Private Dining
items.description: Experience intimate dining in our traditional seating area perfect for family gatherings

items.name: Outdoor BBQ
items.description: Enjoy grilled meats and vegetables in our beautiful outdoor garden setting

items.name: Takeaway & Delivery
items.description: Enjoy our delicious food at home. Fast delivery across Kathmandu valley

items.title: Fresh Local Ingredients
items.description: We source our vegetables and spices directly from local farmers in Nepal

items.title: Authentic Recipes

items.title: Warm Hospitality
